text:
[Council File 23-1032-S1]
City Administrative Officer report relative to six personal services contracts between the Bureau of Sanitation and Arakelian Enterprises, Inc. (dba Athens Services), Nasa Services, Inc., Consolidated Disposal Services, LLC (dba Republic Services, Universal Waste Systems, Ware Disposal, Inc., and USA Waste of California (dba Waste Management), for solid waste collection and disposal services for commercial and multi-family properties.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes Financial policies Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Six city contracts with private haulers, including Athens, Republic and Waste Management, for trash collection and disposal at commercial and multi-family properties.
